Why now AI changed how our engineers work. They now run several coding agents in parallel, and the amount of code we submit doubled in the last six months. Every one of those changes still has to be tested, reviewed and deployed safely. Our job is to make the platform ready for that agentic scale: faster pipelines, a more robust release platform, and new ways to review code with quality. Experience designing and managing cloud infrastructure (Terraform, Argo/ArgoCD, Docker). Experience developing Developer Experience tooling, Software Testing solutions or similar.
